;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syria missile strikes (September 2018)]]
**[[Russia]]n officials state that the country will send [[S-300 missile system|S-300]] [[Surface-to-air missile|air-defense missile]] system to [[Syria]] within two weeks following the [[Syria missile strikes (September 2018)#Downing of Russian aircraft by Syria|downing of Russian aircraft in Syria]]. Russia also stated it will commence [[Radar jamming and deception|jamming radar and satellite signals]] of planes that attack Syrian territory from the [[Mediterranean Sea|Mediterranean]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/russia-says-will-send-newer-s-300-missile-systems-to-syria/2018/09/24/fe22327a-bfdd-11e8-9f4f-a1b7af255aa5_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.thenational.ae/world/mena/russia-to-upgrade-syria-s-air-defence-systems-after-fatal-downing-of-military-aircraft-1.773432 (''The National'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A [[Taliban]] [[prisoner]] kills eight policemen after seizing their weapons. The condition of the Taliban gunman is unknown. [https://www.voanews.com/a/taliban-detainee-goes-on-killing-spree-in-afghan-prison/4584461.html (Voice of America)]

**The foreign ministers of [[Germany]], [[Russia]], the [[United Kingdom]], [[France]], [[China]] and [[Iran]] agree to the creation of a [[Special Purpose Vehicle]], a financial facility in the [[European Union]], to facilitate payments and continue trade with Iran after the [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|US withdrawal from the Iran deal]]. ;Law and crime
*[[Crime in California]]
**Police in California arrest Ramon Escobar, 47, on charges of killing and assaulting homeless people, and are investigating whether he may have attacked a fisherman napping beneath a pier, in the cities of [[Los Angeles]] and [[Santa Monica, California]]. Authorities believe Escobar may be a serial killer, who is now a [[person of interest]] in the disappearance of his aunt and uncle in [[Houston, Texas]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/socal-murder-suspect-may-be-linked-to-houston-disappearances/ (CBS News)]
*[[Dellen Millard and Mark Smich|Dellen Millard]] is convicted of murdering his father Wayne Millard, who owned an aviation company. The death had initially been ruled a suicide. Dellen Millard has already been convicted of two other murders in Canadian court. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45632106 (BBC)] [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-dellen-millard-found-guilty-of-first-degree-murder-for-a-third-time/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
